name: weekly-certification
title: Weekly Benefits Certification
description: The app as one thing: every document this page composes, named by its canonical identity and pinned to the version this release was verified with. The page loads nothing that is not named here — it resolves each reference through the stack's artifact resolver against the documents it ships, and refuses a document whose identity or version does not match its pin. Canonical URLs are identities, not locations: the host resolves them to bytes (here, the site's own copies, also served under form-v2/ for readers and verifiers). Not composed: the retired version 1 Definition (its migration into version 2 lives inside version 2), the Issuer documents (the Definition points at them itself), and the claimant record (a data instance the Definition names, fetched at load). Signing this bundle — the release digest a host admits — is the next step this demo does not take.
